entity.name: MERIT DEM (Multi-Error-Removed Improved-Terrain Digital Elevation Model)

lineage.description: Low-lying areas below 5 meters elevation were identified and delineated from the MERIT DEM, a global high-resolution digital elevation model. The dataset represents terrain susceptibility to inundation based on topographic position and is provided as vector geometries (shapefile and GeoJSON) for Myanmar.

sources.name: MERIT DEM (Multi-Error-Removed Improved-Terrain Digital Elevation Model)
sources.description: Global digital elevation model providing terrain elevation data from which low-lying areas were derived through elevation threshold filtering
